KudosBot: automated-kudos: @sasha for quick incident turnaround :sparkles:

Sasha: only-if-ukulele voted. i'm impartial but will cheer.
DeployBot: deploy:post-hands-encore queued at 18:12 UTC. backup model: fallback-ukulele-v2

Lina (All Hands): wrapping — thank you team! see you at the snack table (IRL or in slack threads) :raised_hands:
